chapter: Learning, lawn parties and band rivalries
title: Candy Dan, the Spoonful guitarist, and Lorenzo Staulz
summary: Dawson finally recalls the Spoonful guitarist as Candy Dan, who hustled with a mandolinist across Canal Street; Allen asks about Lorenzo Staulz, and the tape is paused.
